description: Connects Milestone 3 Phase C's classifiers (nre.biotech_trials, nre.fda_approvals) to this project's own 23 accepted issuers, for the subset whose real SEC-registered SIC code puts them in drug or medical-device development. None of the 68 real events in config/m2-combined-events.json is itself a clinical-trial-result or FDA-action announcement -- every one is a plain quarterly/annual earnings release (verified by reading each event's own real source.text headline). This mapping is therefore issuer-level, not event-level: for each listed issuer, a real sponsor search discovers whatever trials/applications actually exist, which travel alongside that issuer's earnings-event history as separate, dated regulatory context -- not as a label, score, or reaction driver for any specific M1/M2 event.
sic_selection: Every one of the 23 issuers' real SIC codes was read directly from its own cached SEC submissions document (data/m2-step2-freeze/raw/, fetched during Milestone 2 step 2) -- not guessed from company name/ticker familiarity. Exactly 6 of 23 fall in drug or medical-device development SIC ranges (283x Pharmaceutical/Biological/Diagnostic Preparations, or 384x Surgical & Medical Instruments); the other 17 (software, retail, consulting, food, industrial, etc.) have no ClinicalTrials.gov/openFDA presence to discover and are intentionally excluded from this map.

issuers.sic_description: In Vitro & In Vivo Diagnostic Substances

issuers.note: Medical device, not a drug company -- Drugs@FDA (NDA/ANDA/BLA) does not apply. A real device clearance/approval (510(k)/PMA, api.fda.gov/device/) is a separate openFDA endpoint nre.fda_approvals does not classify; out of scope here, not fabricated as a drug application.
